I told Dana the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, and posted that as a reply in her #north-team thread.

- **Why it's 100, not 261:** On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so she can see the correction. Ilse's 261 post in #north-team still hasn't been fixed.
- **Not checked against the contract:** The signed renewal isn't in any files I can see. The team digest only says it was signed on 2026-03-20 and doesn't give a seat count. I told Dana to ask Ilse or June to confirm the number if the tracker needs the contract figure.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, so sharing this with the North team didn't need anyone's approval.
